resources.string: Phone is Flat on Table → Calibrate (5s)
Put your phone flat on a table or firm surface. Once it is resting still, tap \'Calibrate (5s)\' below.
Put your phone flat on a table or firm surface. Once it is resting still, tap \'Calibrate (5s)\' below.
Keep the phone completely still on the table for 5 seconds. Setting zero baseline...
Pick up the phone and place it flat on your chest (screen facing up). Sit back or lie down comfortably. It will detect automatically.
Place phone face down on your chest, and rest your finger gently on the camera light. It will detect automatically.
Monitoring live pulse and blood pressure. Stay relaxed and still. Tap \'Stop & Show Average\' when finished.
Place phone flat on your chest over sternum (screen up). Lie still and relax.
Place phone FACE DOWN on chest (screen against chest, camera up). Rest index finger on camera flash.
Camera and flash access is needed for photoplethysmography (PPG) pulse transit sensing.
First, place the phone flat on a table so it can calibrate zero. This ensures it doesn\'t show a pulse when resting on furniture.
Place the phone flat against the center of your chest. Lie down or lean back in an armchair.
Relax and breathe normally. The phone will count 15 seconds and vibrate when your checkup is complete.
You can press the Volume-Down button on the side of your phone to start without touching the screen.
